answer_1.quote: In this paper, we focus on evaluating the quality of ad texts generated by such models.

answer_2.quote: For binary classification, we use accuracy and F1-score to evaluate the binary labels. In regression, we use Pearson and Spearman correlation coefficients.

answer_3.quote: We employed CALM2 7b and ELYZA 7b as baselines for open LLMs. GPT-4 achieved high performance across all three tasks, using zero-/few-shot prompting.

answer_4.quote: We enlisted three human evaluators who are not involved in AdOps to evaluate all tasks except AD PERFORMANCE ESTIMATION.
answer_4.guideline: In the final assessment, a majority vote per instance was conducted for the AD ACCEPTABILITY and AD CONSISTENCY tasks, while the average scores of evaluator assessments were reported for other tasks.
